model_note: RGB gains are explicit engineering stress profiles, not device calibrations or spectral measurements. All derived metrics use the transformed sRGB values.

nightshift.name: Maximum Night Shift surrogate
nightshift.description: A documented surrogate for the undocumented, display-dependent warmest macOS Night Shift setting. This is the least destructive profile in the set.

redshift.name: Redshift 2000 K signal-LUT
redshift.target: Redshift 2000 K with reset ramps, brightness 1, gamma 1
redshift.description: The pinned Redshift 2000 K gamma-ramp signal transform with identity input ramps, unit brightness, and unit per-channel gamma.

safelight.name: Deep-red 1200 K stress profile
safelight.target: Redshift 1200 K with reset ramps, brightness 1, gamma 1
safelight.description: The pinned Redshift 1200 K signal-LUT transform: blue is removed and green is heavily attenuated. This is a severe visibility stress test, not a claim of physical astronomy safety.
